verdict.label: Steady market
verdict.headline: Card prices are steady: no strong move either way right now.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 79.2 (+2.0% in a day) and momentum is 46: prices are steady. 84s cost 850, 85s 2,800 and 86s 5,600. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-18T23:51:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Patri Guijarro 88 after its 32% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 46,000 coins. Now 44,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 31.9% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 13 of 20 so far, averaging +8.7% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Sell Luis Díaz 89 Team of the week after its 33% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 205,000 coins. Now 140,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 33.1% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 5 of 10 so far, averaging +4.4% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-19T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 850 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,800 (1.33 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,600 (1.37 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,600 (1.38 coins per Item Score point), 88s 13,000 (1.57 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Sandra Villafañe and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Sandra Villafañe 76 Rare -36.5%; Patri Guijarro 88 Rare -34.3%; Luis Díaz 89 Team of the week -33.0%; Paula Perea 75 Rare -32.4%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
